summary: Iteration-4 retest of the two HIGH-priority bugs flagged in iteration_3. BOTH FIXES CONFIRMED WORKING. Bug 1 (Peanut Butter pouch label mirroring): loaded / and waited 15s — 'KRUNCH MATE' and 'SALT & VINEGAR' render right-side up on SV; clicked hero-flavour-pill-peanut-butter, waited 15s — 'KRUNCH MATE' and 'PEANUT BUTTER' render right-side up on PB (no mirroring, no upside-down state). The bounded sin() sway in PouchScene.jsx (±14°) correctly prevents the pouch from crossing 90° so the label stays legible indefinitely. Bug 2 (unit-price rounding): PB 6-pack subtotal = £10.00 (was £10.02); SV 6-pack subtotal = £10.00; Bundle 'The Krunch Six' subtotal = £10.00 (was £10.02); Mix-and-match (3xSV + 6xPB with drawer closed between clicks via [data-testid=cart-drawer-close]) subtotal = £16.00 exactly (was £16.02). Regressions all pass: 3-pack SV = £6.00, single SV = £2.50, hero pill switches teal<->brown and 3D pouch swaps SV<->PB GLB, Story page renders (h1, story-direct-answer, 5 story-section-*, story-signature) with ZERO youtube.com/googlevideo.com requests before click, footer contains 'Snack Smarter, Krunch Now!' and Rajesh's story link, About page timeline shows Early 2024 / Late 2024 / Early 2025 / Late 2025 and about-cta-rajesh navigates to /story-behind-your-krunch, Contact page email = mailto:contact@krunchmate.com and address contains WC2H 9JQ. Backend pytest 4/4 pass (health + 3 subscribe cases).
critical_code_review_comments: React Router v6 future-flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) still fire on every route. Cosmetic, but easy to silence by passing future={{v7_startTransition:true, v7_relativeSplatPath:true}} to <BrowserRouter> before ship.
Footer tagline 'Snack Smarter, Krunch Now!' has no dedicated data-testid; retrieved via text content only. Consider adding data-testid="footer-tagline" to future-proof selector-based tests.

YouTubeFacade pre-click testid is 'youtube-facade-play'; there is no 'youtube-facade' wrapper testid. Doc/testing agents were assuming the latter — add a stable wrapper testid to reduce selector churn.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both HIGH bugs from iteration_3 are now fixed. Correct cart-drawer close selector is [data-testid="cart-drawer-close"] (NOT cart-close as previously assumed). Correct story testids: story-h1, story-direct-answer, story-section-*, story-signature, youtube-facade-play (not youtube-facade). PouchScene.jsx now uses bounded sin() sway so labels never cross 90° — verified stable at 15s and later.
rca of the issue: Fixes verified in code: PouchScene.jsx auto-rotate is now a bounded sin() sway (±14°) instead of unbounded accumulation — pouch never turns backwards so label mirroring can never occur. Shop.jsx no longer pre-rounds unit price (toFixed removed), and BundleUpsell.jsx uses raw 10/6 / 20/12 without toFixed, so cart lineTotal = unit*qty now equals the tier total exactly.
